display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
商品分币种定价
SKU 按 currency_code 定价
(USD/EUR/GBP/CNY…)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
购物车/下单
订单锁定收款币种

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
汇率服务 erik_exchange_rates
manual 手动维护 / exchangerate-api 自动拉取
生效时间 effective_at 版本化

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
发起支付
Stripe / PayPal / Klarna / Adyen
按收款币种原币扣款

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
支付回调 Webhook
payment_intent.succeeded
验签 Gateway::verifyWebhook

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
更新支付/订单
Payments.status=1
Orders.status=1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
平台分账 PlatformSettlements
订单总额 total_amount
平台佣金 platform_fee
支付网关手续费 payment_gateway_fee
currency_code = 订单币种

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
卖家结算 MerchantSettlements
订单金额 → 抽成率 → 结算金额
0待结算 / 1已结算

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
供应商结算 SupplierSettlements
应付供应商货款

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
分销结算 AffiliatePayouts
佣金 + 提现

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
平台收益
平台佣金 + 支付手续费

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
汇兑损益追踪 CurrencyExchangeGainsLosses
收款金额/币种 ↔ 结算金额/币种
支付时汇率 vs 结算时汇率
正=汇兑收益 / 负=汇兑亏损

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
结算完成 settled_at
对账核销 / 审计追溯
